summary: For each encoded integer, its last decimal digit gives a split width. Remove that digit, split the remaining digits after the specified width, and interpret the two parts as positive integers x and y. Sum x raised to y across the array, modulo 1000000007.
officialConstraints: Array length 1..100000; 100 < encoded value < 10^15; width 1..9; 1 <= x,y < 10^9. Each encoding is valid and neither decoded part has leading zeros.
semanticPitfalls: Compute modular powers, not the full enormous power. Encoded integers fit JavaScript safe-integer range, but multiplication during modular exponentiation may not.
title: Sum of Decoded Numbers
